'''Three-way Ceiling Guns''' were dome shaped turrets that were mounted on the ceilings of the Ugnaught and [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|Carbon-freezing chamber]] sub-levels of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. The two halves of the dome would separate before the Three-way Ceiling Gun would fire three separate [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] in opposite directions. The majority of the Three-way Ceiling Gun, excluding the dome, remained embedded in the ceiling.<ref name="SEMP">''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>
